headword: {新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}

definitions.explanation: A trip taken by a newly married couple soon after the wedding.

examples.japanese: {新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ハワイ→ハワイ：30806_hawai⟧だった。
examples.english: We went to Hawaii for our honeymoon.

examples.japanese: {新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Where are you planning to go on your honeymoon?

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦{経|た}って→経つ：09892_tatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}けた→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Work was so busy that we only managed to go on our honeymoon a year after the wedding.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go on a honeymoon
- {新婚旅行|しんこんりょこう}{先|さき}: honeymoon destination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ハネムーン: honeymoon; a loanword with a more romantic, travel-industry feel
- ⟦{新婚|しんこん}→新婚：12879_shinkon⟧: newly married (⟦{新婚|しんこん}→新婚：12879_shinkon⟧さん, a newlywed couple)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Hawaii and Europe have long been favorite honeymoon destinations for Japanese couples; in the 1960s and 70s Miyazaki and other parts of Kyushu were the classic choice.
